test_title: PYST 02: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Venus didn’t have any moons or satellites or even a ________ field, but it did have an atmosphere sort of similar to Earth’s, except it was super-hot.
solution:
The correct answer is '**magnetic**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**magnetic**" refers to having the properties of a magnet; that is, exerting an attractive force. (चुंबकीय)
 
• In the context of planets, having a magnetic field means the planet generates a magnetic environment around itself.
 
• The other options: "**pedagogic**," "**graphological**," and "**musicological**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Venus didn't have any moons or satellites or even a magnetic__ field, but it did have an atmosphere sort of similar to Earth's, except it was super-hot.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Pedagogic (शैक्षणिक)**: means relating to teaching or education.
 
• **Graphological (लेखनी)**: means related to the study of handwriting.
 
• **Musicological (संगीतिक)**: means related to the scholarly study of music.
